description: An immutable implementation of the 'ThingDefinition' interface, providing factory methods for creation, parsing, and accessors for attributes such as namespace, name, and version.

classes.name: ImmutableThingDefinition
classes.description: An immutable, final class implementing 'ThingDefinition', encapsulating a 'DefinitionIdentifier' and providing static factory methods for instantiation and parsing.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutableThingDefinition instance with specified namespace, name, and version.

methods.name: ofParsed
methods.description: Parses a CharSequence representation of a ThingDefinition identifier and returns an ImmutableThingDefinition instance.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace of the definition.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the definition.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version of the definition.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code based on the delegate.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the underlying delegate's CharSequence.

methods.name: charAt
methods.description: Returns the character at the specified index.

methods.name: subSequence
methods.description: Returns a subsequence of the delegate.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the delegate.
